title: Who will be appointed to succeed Pape Thiaw as head coach of Senegal's men's national football team by August 31, 2026?
background: The Senegalese Football Federation is responsible for appointing the national team's head coach.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement by the Senegalese Football Federation, as confirmed by contemporaneous reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the person publicly announced as Pape Thiaw's successor between August 1 and August 31, 2026. The resolution date is the date the appointment is publicly announced, rather than the coach's presentation or first match.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointed coach's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: The FSF executive committee fired Thiaw and his staff on Jul 11 (announced Jul 12). L'Equipe names Vieira as favourite, but Senenews (Jul 12) quotes FSF sources saying he is not the priority and calls Omar Daf the most credible pick on budget grounds. Renard (free since leaving Tunisia Jul 4, lives in Senegal; costly) and Beye are also cited. No decision as of Jul 19.

title: Who will President Donald Trump nominate in 2026 to succeed Marty Makary as FDA commissioner?
background: Marty Makary resigned as commissioner of the US Food and Drug Administration in May 2026, leaving the position vacant. The president nominates the commissioner, subject to Senate confirmation.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official presidential announcement or reliable news reporting directly quoting that announcement.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first person President Trump publicly announces as his nominee for FDA commissioner after Makary’s May 2026 resignation and before the end of 2026. The nomination announcement is sufficient; Senate confirmation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The nominee’s full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: STAT (~Jul 10): three finalists (Overton, oncologist Jeffrey Vacirca, DoD health official Stephen Ferrara) were sent to the White House for a final decision, with no nominee as of Jul 16. Food Safety News (Jun 30) says some reports have Ferrara as front-runner; Daily Caller (Jul 9) says Overton is favored. RFK Jr.'s backing for Overton is unclear.

title: To which hospital will Pakistan’s Supreme Court order Imran Khan transferred for medical care in August 2026?
background: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan is imprisoned at Adiala jail. His eye condition has required specialist treatment, and concerns about his health have been central to his party’s campaign for his release.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Supreme Court’s order or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations describing its requirements.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the hospital designated in the Supreme Court’s next order, issued after the start date and during August 2026, directing Khan’s transfer from Adiala jail for hospital care.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the hospital.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Pending SC petitions (Uzma Khan; Imran May 19; early-hearing plea Jun 18) all pray for transfer to Shifa International. The SC returned earlier pleas, and the CJP said the health issue was 'not pending'. All 5 eye injections were given at PIMS (latest Jun 14), the likely middle-path venue. Essentially a coin flip.

title: If Daniil Medvedev loses a men's singles match at the 2026 Cincinnati Open, which player will defeat him?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Conditional on Medvedev losing a men's singles match at the 2026 Cincinnati Open, according to the tournament's official match results. A pre-match withdrawal or walkover does not count as a match loss.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-18
  • Accepted Answer Format: Full name of his victorious opponent

title: Who will win the 2026 Republican U.S. House primary featuring Florida incumbent Cory Mills?
background: Cory Mills is seeking a third term in the U.S. House of Representatives.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Florida Division of Elections results or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the primary winner.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the winner of the Florida Republican U.S. House primary in which Cory Mills is a candidate, scheduled for August 18, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Mills has Trump's endorsement, the anti-Mills vote is split, and Florida has no runoff (market about 85-90% Mills, Jun 27). But he raised under $60K in Q2 and has only $81K cash. Elijah won the Seminole Hob Nob straw poll (Jul 9: 45-35-16) and was endorsed by state Sen. Tom Wright (Jul 20). The ethics probe is ongoing.

title: Who will be the first major Ukrainian political figure to publicly call for wartime elections following Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion?
background: Ukrainian law bars elections during wartime. The presidential election has been postponed under continuing martial law, although Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s presidential term ended in May 2024.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: Identify the person credited in reliable reporting with the first public call by a major Ukrainian political figure since Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion to resume national elections while the war continues. A call solely for elections after the war ends does not qualify.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the qualifying statement becomes public, provided this occurs by August 31, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The politician’s full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Kuleba said Ukraine needs wartime elections (Focus Feb 19; KURS Apr 14, 2026, calling himself 'in a critical minority'). The July crisis (Fedorov fired, 5+ days of protests, Syrskyi removed Jul 21) and a UP report of a Zelensky-Zaluzhnyi talk about an 'election window' raise the odds of a new figure being credited. Fedorov added as a newly popular rival.

title: Who will win Florida's 2026 Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate special election?
background: Florida is holding a special election to complete the U.S. Senate term vacated by Marco Rubio after he became secretary of state.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Florida Division of Elections results or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the primary winner.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the winner of Florida's Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate special election, scheduled for August 18, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Change Research (Jul 9-11) has Vindman 34-24 with 41% undecided. Vindman has raised $16.7M vs Nixon's ~$625K. Nixon edged a tiny Seminole Hob Nob straw poll (31-29), polls slightly better vs Moody (UNF, Jul 20), and progressive insurgents have been winning 2026 Democratic primaries.

title: Which Ukrainian suspect, if any, will be arrested in August 2026 in connection with Germany's investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline bombings?
background: Germany is investigating the September 2022 explosions that damaged the Nord Stream gas pipelines. A former Ukrainian army officer was arrested in Italy in August 2025 and transferred to Germany that November.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Confirmation from German federal prosecutors or the authorities carrying out the arrest, as reported by reliable news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Ukrainian suspect physically arrested during August 2026 pursuant to a German warrant concerning the September 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. The issuance of a warrant without an actual arrest does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The suspect's full name. If no qualifying arrest occurs during August 2026, answer “None”.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Germany indicted Serhii K. (Kuznietsov) in Hamburg on Jul 2. There are no reports of other suspects being located. The remaining suspects are believed to be in Ukraine, which denies involvement, and Poland refused to extradite Zhuravlov in Oct 2025. A new arrest in a specific month is unlikely, though summer travel led to the 2025 arrests.

title: Which armed group will the United States explicitly identify as an Iranian proxy in an August 2026 designation update?
background: The United States uses counterterrorism designations and financial sanctions to target armed organizations and their funding networks.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official U.S. Treasury or State Department announcement issued during August 2026, corroborated by contemporaneous reliable reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: The announcement must explicitly update an armed group's existing U.S. designation to identify that group as an Iranian proxy. A statement alleging Iranian support without announcing a designation update does not qualify.
  • Resolution Date: The date the qualifying designation update is publicly announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The commonly used name of the armed group whose designation is updated.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: OFAC's Iran actions resumed after the MOU collapsed: Hezbollah finance with the TFTC (Jun 30), Ansari (Jul 10), Shamkhani network (Jul 14) and IRGC procurement (Jul 15). No designation update relabeling a group as an Iranian proxy was found. Low information, so masses were trimmed slightly.

title: Who will win the 2026 special election for California's 14th congressional district?
background: A special election will fill the U.S. House vacancy created by Eric Swalwell's resignation in April 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Consistent winner projections reported by major U.S. news organizations based on special-election results.
  • Resolution Event: Resolve when a winner is publicly projected for the special election to complete Swalwell's unexpired term. The November 2026 election for the following full term does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.

title: Who will be exercising the duties of governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state on August 21, 2026?
background: Sinaloa's governor took a leave of absence on May 1 after being indicted by U.S. prosecutors on drug-trafficking charges. The question concerns who actually performs the governor's duties, rather than who retains the title while on leave.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Mexican government statements and contemporaneous news reporting identifying the person exercising Sinaloa's gubernatorial duties on August 21, 2026.
  • Resolution Rule: If the elected governor remains on leave, resolve to the acting governor. If the elected governor has resumed duties by that date, resolve to the elected governor.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The officeholder's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Bonilla remains interim governor. She gave birth Jun 30 but declined maternity leave and governs remotely (Jul 3-7 reports). Sheinbaum refuses to arrest or extradite Rocha (ProPublica Jul 13), and there is no sign he will return from his indefinite leave.

title: As of August 20, 2026, which tournament will Carlos Alcaraz have confirmed as his planned return from his wrist injury?
background: Carlos Alcaraz withdrew from the Barcelona Open in April 2026 because of a wrist injury, leaving the timing of his return to competitive tennis uncertain.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements from Carlos Alcaraz, as reported by reliable sports-news outlets.
  • Resolution: Identify the tournament named in his most recent public confirmation available by August 20, 2026, as his intended first tournament back following his April wrist injury. Resolve according to his confirmed comeback plan, not whether he subsequently participates.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The tournament's name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Alcaraz withdrew from Montreal and is on the Cincinnati (Aug 13-23) entry list. Organisers and his team say the comeback is planned there (Jul 16). But as of Jul 20 he was still hitting at low intensity with no sets played and wore a wrist guard on Jul 19. A Cincinnati withdrawal would likely shift the target to the US Open.
